selection: Evolved from the 40 strongest strategies of all earlier batches on their own forward days: parameter steps, crossovers and moves to other coins, screened on the history and the forward days so far at real-money scoring (profitable in both, >= 100 history and >= 20 forward trades), best 300 by t-stat. The forward days so far were used to breed them, so only days after the freeze count as their test.
